[NSEB 2015 — question paper]
48. The support staff in a Zoology lab mixed up the description charts of the following
organisms:
X: Rotifer Y: Sea anemone Z: Spider
Description charts:
I: Coelomate with segmented body.
II: Pseudocoelomate with alimentary canal and head having ciliated crown.
III: Diploblastic with gastrovascular cavity.
Description charts that match X, Y and Z respectively are:
a) I, II and III
b) II, III and I
c) III, I and II
d) I, III and II

[INBO 2020 — question paper]
18. (1 point) The internal structures of a marine life form, Pseudoceros bifurcus are shown in the
figure. Mark the correct interpretation.
Pseudoceros bifurcus
The animal is most likely is:
a. a cnidarian as it shows tissue level organization with bilateral symmetry.
b. a free-living platyhelminth as it shows bilateral symmetry and has an acoelomate body plan.
c. a free-living platyhelminth as it shows non-segmented body plan and absence of circulatory
system.
d. a parasitic platyhelminth as it shows suckers, hermaphrodity and absence of sense organs.
